summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature without running tests or repository code, and without committing. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] shape in ControlCode. rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 formatter entry (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and the Control.title classmethod, which passes the (type, title) pair as one argument. rich/console.py adds set_window_title beside set_alt_screen, gated only on is_terminal, returning True or False. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds a SET_WINDOW_TITLE branch that calls term.set_title(title). CHANGELOG.md gains an Added bullet under Unreleased linking PR 2200. Tests were appended to tests/test_console.py, tests/test_control.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py. Verification was by reading only; the test suite has not been run.
